title: Rochester, MN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Rochester, MN: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Rochester is a city in MN with a population of 120,000. Home of the Mayo Clinic with a world-class medical sector and growing biotech industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
